item.title: Is it still possible to change the future of our planet? Read more in our 2023 Annual Review - IKEA Foundation
item.description: For our 2023 Annual Review, we asked some of our partners to reflect on their progress and learnings from the year, as they worked to create sustainable change. Each of the stories from our partners stands for an important milestone on the journey to lasting positive change.
